item.title: Xcraft 1.0
item.description: • Projects open with just the agent and the canvas. Show the components sidebar or the inspector with the toolbar buttons when you need them.

item.title: Xcraft 1.0
item.description:
• iPhone Duo folds for real: open it, close it or stop anywhere in between, and your app keeps running as iOS moves it between the cover and the inner screen. Pick Closed, Half Open or Open Flat, or drag the hinge angle.
  • Swiping up from the bottom of the simulator screen goes Home, as on the phone.
  • Components you add from the library are Apple's plain native ones: a toggle is just a toggle, ready for you to style.
  • The canvas and your running app line up more closely: spacing, padding, chips and buttons.
  • Settings switches tabs instantly and no longer cuts off the bottom of a page.
  • The canvas follows light and dark mode as soon as you change it.

item.title: Xcraft 1.0
item.description:
• A new look that fits right in on your Mac: native controls, the system font, a Liquid Glass toolbar and a blue accent.
  • The agent has its own column next to the canvas. Chat with it like Messages; screens and components stay in the sidebar.
  • A Projects window shows every app as its icon. Press + for a new project and describe it to the agent.
  • Run shows your app inside Xcraft, in a real iPhone Simulator in its device frame, with touch, scrolling and typing.
  • Setting up Xcode takes a few plain steps, and Xcraft notices when each one is done.
  • The canvas matches the app on a real iPhone more closely: buttons, spacing, fields and tab bars.
  • A new app icon.

item.title: Xcraft 1.0
item.description:
• Every app now keeps its data on the device with SwiftData. Firebase will return in a later version.
  • Projects already connected to Firebase keep working.

item.title: Xcraft 1.0
item.description:
• Xcraft is now $19 once, yours for life
  • Support is now at xcraftmac@gmail.com

item.title: Xcraft 1.0
item.description:
• Xcraft is now a one-time purchase: try everything free for 7 days, then buy a license for up to 2 Macs at xcraftformac.com
  • Works without Xcode: design, generate SwiftUI and export right away; install Xcode whenever you want to run or publish apps
  • Automatic build fixes repair the compile error instead of re-planning the app
  • The canvas keeps sample values for your app's logic, so screens no longer show property names like "Top streak text"
  • Version history can be switched on from inside Xcraft by installing Apple's free developer tools
  • Fixed the window buttons slipping to the top edge after switching between light and dark mode
  • Security improvements for generated projects, Git and the AI tools Xcraft runs

item.title: Xcraft 1.0
item.description:
• Fixed apps with a screen named "Progress" (and similar) failing to build
  • A new app now builds into the blank Home screen instead of next to it

item.title: Xcraft 1.0
item.description:
• Sign in to Firebase, Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini right inside Xcraft: no Terminal, no setup questions
  • Missing tools are installed for you, without an administrator password
  • Fixed Firebase sign-in failing with "Your credentials are no longer valid" on some Node.js versions

item.title: Xcraft 1.0
item.description:
• Generated apps: detail and form screens start at the top on device, like on the canvas
  • Live build: a new screen appears only after the AI arrow finishes the previous one
  • Changes card: new files show as added, edited files as changed

item.title: Xcraft 1.0
item.description: • Canvas: screens the AI edits are redrawn from their final content, so a tab added by the AI shows on every screen's tab bar

item.title: Xcraft 1.0
item.description:
• App icon: removed the light line along the top edge
  • App icon: the shadow is no longer cut off at small sizes
